mandates.thresholdNote: Businesses with annual revenue exceeding PLN 200 million from 2026-02-01; all B2B transactions across all companies from 2026-04-01. Previously delayed from an earlier planned 2024 date.
mandates.notes: Format is the FA(3) logical structure (a native KSeF XML schema, not Peppol BIS), replacing FA(2) for every invoice issued from 2026-02-01. Foreign VAT-exempt businesses are exempt.
